title: How long ago did each event happen?
prompt: Place each event by how long ago it took place.

items.label: The Berlin Wall fell
items.fact: The wall came down in 1989 after 28 years dividing the city.

items.label: The first Moon landing
items.fact: Apollo 11 touched down in 1969, watched live by 600 million people.

items.label: Gutenberg’s printing press
items.fact: Around 1440, movable type began making books affordable.

items.label: The fall of Rome
items.fact: The Western Roman Empire dissolved in 476 CE.

items.label: The end of the last Ice Age
items.fact: As the ice retreated, humans began farming and settling.

items.label: The dinosaurs went extinct
items.fact: A city-sized asteroid strike ended the age of dinosaurs.
